name: Single-Arm Cross-Body Cable Extension
description: A cable isolation exercise where one arm reaches across the body to a cable attachment at shoulder height. The cross-body angle creates a unique line of pull that emphasizes the lateral head of the triceps with constant cable tension throughout the movement.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Single-Arm Cross-Body Cable Extension in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Single-Arm Cross-Body Cable Extension.
steps: Step 1: Stand sideways to cable, reach across body to grasp handle at shoulder height.
Step 2: Keep upper arm fixed and extend elbow pressing hand across body.
Step 3: Extend to lockout feeling the lateral head contract.
Step 4: Return slowly with control, stretching across the body.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Feel the cross-body stretch at the bottom
